title: 第8章 分家要公平-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “国强，你倒是不知道客气。”

    周桂芳忍不住了，阴阳怪气地说了一句，“这肉是妈炖了给大伙儿吃的，你一个人可劲造，别人还吃不吃了？”

    林国强头也没抬：“大嫂，之前你们吃肉可没喊过我们一家，我们刚吃几块你就心疼了？”

    周桂芳被噎住了，脸涨得通红。

    “行了行了，吃个饭哪来那么多话。”

    林海柱终于开口了，声音不大，但堂屋里立刻安静了下来。

    老爷子把茶缸放下，双手撑在膝盖上，扫了一圈桌上的儿女们。

    “今天叫你们来，是有件事要说。”

    所有人的筷子都停了下来。

    林海柱沉默了一会儿，像是在组织语言，又像是在做最后的挣扎。

    “你妈和我商量了，”他终于开口了，声音沙哑，像砂纸磨过木头，“咱们这个家，也该分分了。”

    分家。

    这两个字像一颗石子投进了平静的水面，激起了层层涟漪。

    林国伟和周桂芳对视了一眼，两人脸上都有一种“终于来了”的表情，嘴角微微上翘，但很快压了下去。

    林国栋叼着烟，眯着眼睛，看不出什么情绪，但他的手在桌子底下攥了攥。

    林美玲微微皱起了眉，嘴唇动了动，没说话。

    赵素梅的身体僵了一下，手里的筷子停在半空，林薇在她怀里扭了扭，她赶紧低头哄了哄。

    林国强夹了一块土豆，慢慢地嚼着，脸上的表情没有任何变化。

    他早就知道会有这一天。

    上一世，分家是在半年后。

    那时候他手里的钱已经被“借”得差不多了。

    分家的时候，他分到的是一块河滩边的薄田和两间快塌了的土坯房。

    外加那头驴的“使用权”。

    名义上是他的，实际上还是大家共用。

    而大哥分到了三间砖瓦房和村东头最好的五亩水浇地。

    老三分了缝纫机和自行车，外加两百块钱的“创业资金”。

    公平吗？

    不公平。

    但上一世他没吭声。

    他觉得兄弟姐妹之间，计较这些没意思。

    他相信自己能凭双手挣出来。

    结果呢？

    他挣了一辈子，什么都没挣到。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"Guoqiang, you don't know how to be polite."

Zhou Guifang couldn't help it anymore and said angrily, "My mother stewed this meat for everyone to eat. If you can cook it all by yourself, will others eat it?"

Lin Guoqiang didn't even raise his head: "Sister-in-law, you have never called us a family before you ate meat. You feel distressed after we just ate a few pieces?"

Zhou Guifang was choked and her face turned red.

“Okay, okay, how can we talk so much over a meal.”

Lin Haizhu finally spoke, not loudly, but the hall immediately fell silent.

The old man put down the teapot, put his hands on his knees, and glanced around the children on the table.

"I called you here today because I have something to say."

Everyone’s chopsticks stopped.

Lin Haizhu was silent for a while, as if he was organizing his words or making a final struggle.

"Your mother and I have discussed it," he finally spoke, his voice hoarse, like sandpaper rubbing against wood, "It's time for our family to be divided."

Separate the family.

These two words are like a stone thrown into the calm water, causing ripples.

Lin Guowei and Zhou Guifang looked at each other. Both of them had an expression of "finally here" on their faces. The corners of their mouths were slightly raised, but they were quickly suppressed.

Lin Guodong held a cigarette in his mouth and squinted his eyes. He couldn't see any emotion, but his hands were clenched under the table.

Lin Meiling frowned slightly, moved her lips, but said nothing.

Zhao Sumei’s body stiffened for a moment, the chopsticks in her hand stopped in mid-air, Lin Wei twisted in her arms, and she quickly lowered her head to coax him.

Lin Guoqiang picked up a piece of potato and chewed it slowly, without any change in the expression on his face.

He had known for a long time that this day would come.

In my last life, the family was separated half a year later.

By that time, almost all the money in his hand had been "borrowed".

When the family was separated, what he received was a piece of thin land by the river beach and two adobe houses that were about to collapse.

plus the “right to use” the donkey.

It is nominally his, but in fact it is shared by everyone.

The eldest brother was assigned three brick houses and the best five acres of irrigated land at the east end of the village.

The old man bought a sewing machine and a bicycle, plus two hundred yuan of "start-up capital."

Is it fair?

It’s not fair.

But in the last life, he didn’t say a word.

He feels that it is meaningless to care about these things between brothers and sisters.

He believed he could earn it with his own hands.

What’s the result?

He has earned nothing all his life.
